column3: ランスと他の女の子達・・適度に楽しげに会話
column4: Rance and the other girls... moderately enjoying their conversation.

column4: Alright, who tonight... huh, looking at Sill, she was sleeping comfortably.

column3: こいつ奴隷のくせにご主人様をほって寝やがって・・叩き起こして・・
column4: This guy's my slave, yet she just left her master and fell asleep... I'll have to wake her up...

column3: ま、いいか・・
column4: Well, whatever...

column3: よう相棒、いよいよ明日だな。

column3: なんだ、お前・・あっちいけ
column4: What the... you? Go away.

column3: まぁ、そういうなよ。
column4: Ah, don't be like that.

column3: なんだか墓に酒をかけているみたいだな。
column4: It's kind of like pouring alcohol on a grave.

column3: ランスて出会った俺は幸せ、お前はほんとすごい男だ
column4: Meeting Rance made me happy. You truly are an amazing man.

column3: 儂が人間だった時、魔人は一体も倒せなかった。
column4: When I was human, I couldn't defeat a single Fiend.

column3: 魔人を倒す力が欲しい・・そう願い、この姿になった
column4: I wanted the power to defeat Fiends... so I wished for that and took this form.

column3: ガイが儂のオーナーになった時は期待した、あの男はすごかった
column4: When Gai became my owner, I had high hopes; that man was amazing.

column3: あっ、ガイってのちの魔王になる男だぞ、すごい奴だったぞ
column4: Oh, Gai is the man who would become the Demon King later; he was incredible.

column3: お前なんかよりずっと強かった、かっこよかった、が・・甘かったのかな
column4: He was much stronger and cooler than you, but... maybe he was too naive.

column3: 魔人は一体も倒す事なく、奴自身が魔人になってしまった。
column4: Without defeating a single Fiend, he himself became one.

column3: その後、儂はジルを封印する為にリーザスの地下へ・・・
column4: After that, I went underground in Leazas to seal Jill...

column3: それからお前と出会った、うーん、この男駄目かなぁと最初は思っていたさ
column4: And then I met you. Hmm, at first I thought this guy might be hopeless.

column3: だが、お前はすごい奴だった、次々と魔人を倒した。
column4: But you were amazing, defeating Fiends one after another.

column3: 儂が魔剣になった意味を成就してくれた、本当にありがとう。
column4: You fulfilled the meaning of me becoming a demon sword. Truly, thank you.

column3: 明日も頼むぜ、相棒。一緒にこの世界から魔王、魔人を消し去ろう。
column4: I'm counting on you tomorrow too, partner. Let's erase the Demon King and Fiends from this world together.

column3: いや、女の子は助けるぞ。
column4: No, I'll save the girls.
